role: Developer entry point for every gate, test and build task; `make ci` is the local equivalent of ci.yml, and gates.yml invokes many targets on Linux.
toplevel: Sets SHELL=/bin/bash, overridable SCHEME/PROJECT defaults, and a .PHONY list naming every target (including codemap-setup, codemap-guard, codemap-report and codemap-impact) (localization-orphan-guard appears twice, harmless). All targets are thin wrappers around scripts/*.sh, Tools/copy_linter/lint.py, scripts/generate_sbom.py, swiftlint/swiftformat or xcodebuild; their behaviour is in the unit records.

flags.text: gates.yml (the only automatically triggered workflow) claims to run every `make ci` gate that is plain bash/python, listing what it omits and why, but its target lists omit `coremotion-isolation-guard` and `hr-feed-link-guard`, both plain bash scripts with no Xcode/SwiftLint/plutil need. These guard a SIGTRAP crash that lost a recorded walk and an HR-subscribe hang that lost a night; they now run only on manual ci.yml or local `make ci` — the exact gap Makefile:48 says was fixed. gates.yml duplicates the Makefile `ci` list by hand, and check_gates_wired.sh audits only ci.yml, so nothing detects the omission.

flags.text: .ci/min_coverage_views.txt holds 43.5, a non-integer; check_budget_monotonicity.sh read_int() rejects anything not ^[0-9]+$ and the loop `continue`s, so the views coverage floor is never compared and can be lowered with no budget-raise-ok trailer while the ratchet prints clean. Its header lists only three floors (min_coverage, min_coverage_logic, min_localization_coverage).

flags.text: The `ci` comment says it is "the same set ci.yml runs", but `ci` omits release-build while ci.yml's tests job runs `make release-build` (the optimizer-only diagnostics that once broke every Release archive), so a local `make ci` can pass on code whose Release build fails.

flags.text: The Makefile says ci-local runs 'what CI runs' and 'cannot drift', but simulate_ci.sh drops the thread-sanitizer job for --scope unit, while ci.yml runs that job on every scope except gates. A local `make ci-local-unit` therefore passes without the TSan run that a `unit` dispatch requires.
